target.expected_old_value: Scheduled exercise record covers every fallback path.
target.proposed_replacement: For scheduled reservation drain, observe the approved §7.3 boundaries: destination capacity checked and new sessions stopped at T−15; at T−10 no new requests or sticky continuations are admitted and queued requests are rerouted. Handle in-flight work under the approved maximum duration; cancellation does not itself authorize re-dispatch. Re-dispatch is conditional on cancellation outcome, deadline, budget exposure, pinned mode and a currently permitted fallback, otherwise queue or fail explicitly. Migration is staggered. Handover is declared only when no requests remain active and the demo model is loaded and health-checked. Manual emergency drain uses the same in-flight treatment. Timings are validated against measured cancellation, model-preparation and health-check durations; numeric values remain the baseline's initial defaults until confirmed.
